summary: Neo Ensemble's flanger: freq the LFO in Hz, min. delay and depth (the sweep's ends) its delay at the sweep's geometric centre and its octaves, feedback to ±99 %, dry out and wet out a crossfade and an output gain. An inverted dry or wet (Jeskola's default wet out is −100 %) has no counterpart.

rules.why: Both in Hz; measured: the sweep's period is twice what freq says (freq 0.25 Hz: 8.0 s; 1 Hz: 2.0 s), so the LFO runs at half its text.

measured (Windows, ChorusAndFlangerCalibration: the delay read from input and output over a render): the delay sweeps in a triangle from min. delay up by depth × 9.92 ms (depth 127 → 9.9 ms, 64 → 5.0 ms, 32 → 2.5 ms, at any min. delay). Neo Ensemble sweeps in octaves round its Delay: the same ends, its centre where their ratio is halved (2 octaves either side at 100 %).
Both in %; Neo Ensemble's stops at ±99 % (Jeskola's runs away at +100 %: machine-safety.md §3.4). Not measured: the two loops may weigh their feedback differently.

Jeskola's dry and wet add at their own levels, both straight in amplitude (measured: dry 100 % ×1, 50 % ×½; wet 100 % as loud as dry 100 %); Neo Ensemble crossfades them and sets the output's level: mix = wet ÷ (dry + wet), output = dry + wet.

remarks: Jeskola Flanger is mono (it hears left + right, +6 dB, and plays the same on both sides): Neo Ensemble's Spread is 0°, so its two sides sweep alike.
Jeskola sweeps its delay in a straight-line triangle, Neo Ensemble in octaves (its Triangle): at the same ends Neo Ensemble spends longer on the short delays.
At depth 0 Jeskola's delay doesn't hold still (measured: with min. delay 5 ms it wandered over 10–23 ms); Neo Ensemble's holds at min. delay.

Jeskola Flanger's default wet out is −100 %: its comb has its notches where a positive wet has its peaks (a cut at the lowest frequencies). Neo Ensemble has no polarity for its wet sound, so a song at those settings changes sound; the result says so.

A sweep from no delay (min. delay 0, the default) reaches higher in frequency than Neo Ensemble's, whose full depth in Flanger mode spans 16 : 1: the top is kept, the bottom stops at a sixteenth of it.
